summary: @ornikar/graphql-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The preinstall entrypoint setup.mjs is obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers and per-function property maps, hiding a dropper that probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform-arch>.zip`, extracts it, sets it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled CJS bundle (obfuscator.io-style: shuffled string-array with a rotator function, decoder alphabet, hex-mangled identifiers). The size, obfuscation, and use of a second runtime to execute the bundle are inconsistent with the advertised purpose of a graphql-config helper. Execution occurs automatically on `npm install` before any user consent, and the payload's behavior cannot be observed by static inspection of Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
